items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce & Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe strongly recommends applying this update to protect against potential exploits.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Amasty extensions
items.summary: Sansec reported a critical vulnerability in 25 Amasty extensions, with one leading to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks the critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This Incorrect Authorization vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to Adobe Commerce. It affects multiple versions and has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 7.5.

items.title: Adobe Commerce DOS Vulnerability
items.summary: A denial-of-service vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, caused by a vulnerable third-party component, can be triggered remotely without authentication, leading to application crashes and storefront disruption.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files using a polyglot technique to bypass validation. While Magento 2.4.9 contains a fix, older supported versions remain vulnerable.

items.title: Critical Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security mechanisms, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and compromise customer accounts. Adobe recommends applying patches quickly to avoid potential attacks.
